description_expanded: This stately Mediterranean-style 30A vacation home sits directly across from the sugary shoreline in Dune Allen Beach . It includes five bedrooms, six and one-half bathrooms, and accommodations for fourteen beach-loving guests. It stands three stories tall with columned porches and balconies on each level that overlook a private courtyard swimming pool and the glowing jewel-toned gulf. Comfortable furnishings are provided for poolside dining and tropical drinks. The pool features a connected spillover tub for pampered relaxation and is less than a minute away from the bright white sand beach. In no time at all, you may go from taking a refreshing splash in the pool to luxuriating in the gorgeous gulf. Sea Vue includes a game room and two guest bedrooms on the home's first level. The game room has a captivating coastal-style setting with a foosball table, a table for card games, a cream-colored couch with a matching love seat, a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV for entertainment, a wine cooler, and access to a full bath with a walk-in shower. A lovely guest bedroom nearby has a queen-sized bed and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. The adjacent custom-built bunk room for six features a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV and a private ensuite bath with a tub shower combination. Head upstairs to find the second level with a spacious living, dining, and kitchen area. Glass windows and doors frame the sensational seascape while providing access to a furnished beach-side balcony for entertaining. It has vivid views of the pool below and the glorious gulf across the street. A spiral staircase leads down to the poolside patio for added convenience. The open living room has parchment-toned hardwood tile flooring and soaring ceilings lavished with unique tray beams. Two dove gray cloth couches and regal royal blue accent chairs provide an elegant coastal-styled seating ensemble facing a large flatscreen TV. A charming dining area near the open kitchen includes eight cream-colored cottage-style chairs around a rectangular table accented by a gleaming beveled-edge mirror. The state-of-the-art, nautically colored kitchen features brushed stainless steel appliances, navy blue custom cabinetry, and white stone countertops. Four plush cream-colored stools with cushioned tops invite you to enjoy additional space for wining and dining. A guest bedroom on this level has a stately look with a raised dark panel headboard on a king-sized bed and an ensuite bath with a walk-in shower. A half bath off the living area serves as a powder room. The primary bedroom suite and another guest bedroom are on the top level with access to a balcony that provides stunning gulf views. The master bedroom features rich coastal-style furnishings with a king-sized bed, a seating area, and access to the covered gulf view balcony. The majestic ensuite luxury bath has an antique cabinet dresser, two individual raised bowl vanity sinks, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. The stylish guest bedroom with its own private bath features white beach-washed furnishings, a king-sized bed, a seating area, and direct access to the breezy balcony. This outstanding Dune Allen Beach locale is very close to the nationally acclaimed Santa Rosa Beach village center of Gulf Place . It is home to restaurants with casual bars, a caterer, a coffee shop, fashion boutiques, specialty shops, and galleries. An outdoor palm-lined amphitheater in its center provides the perfect place to enjoy live concerts, art shows, and fun festivals that are held throughout the year. It is also near popular restaurants, friendly beach bars with live music, grocery stores, shopping adventures, and abundant amusements. First Floor: Game Room with Walk-In Shower and Patio Access, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower,  Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk and Twin Trundle + Twin Bunk and Tub/Shower Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room. Third Floor: King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Laundry. *Add $50.00 per day to heat pool (available Oct-April if needed)
